One-call HTML report

Source: R/report.R
mv_report.Rd

Writes a self-contained HTML report (no internet connection or extra software needed to open it) covering the plain-language summary, model fit, item statistics and parameters, graphics, a sum-score conversion table, optional item health cards and the R code needed to reproduce the analysis.

Usage

mv_report(
  x,
  file = "mirtverse-report.html",
  title = "IRT analysis report",
  author = NULL,
  cards = NULL,
  alpha = 0.01,
  dif = NULL,
  code = NULL,
  extra = NULL,
  open = interactive() && !isTRUE(getOption("mirtverse.dry_run"))
)

Arguments

x

a unidimensional model from mirt::mirt(), or an mv_model_selection object from select_model() (the report then adds the model comparison and describes the recommended model).

file

path of the .html file to write.

title

report title.

author

optional author line.

cards

logical; include an item health card for every item. Defaults to TRUE for tests of up to 40 items.

alpha

significance level for item misfit.

dif

optional mv_dif object from dif(); adds a section on differential item functioning.

code

optional character vector of R code to show in the reproducibility section (the workbench fills this in automatically).

extra

optional named list of extra sections, each a piece of HTML built with htmltools, placed before the reproducibility section; the names are the section titles. pipeline_report() uses this for its decisions section.

open

logical; open the report in a browser afterwards.

Value

The path to the report, invisibly.

Examples

# \donttest{
mod <- mirt(Science, 1, verbose = FALSE)
f <- mv_report(mod, file = tempfile(fileext = ".html"))
# }
